messages:
rachel: Quick nudge on postmortem Action Item #7 (backup window fix) — due date passed and owner is @diego. Any status?

diego: Sorry, missed this. I ran into a batching edge with cold-starts that extends the backup window. Have a small patch ready, need one more infra review. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4701. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item #7 assigned to diego is overdue (due 1807623599). Please update the incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-201/actions.

rachel: If it's going to slip past tomorrow we need a short mitigation: can we add a temporary stagger to backups to avoid overlap?

diego: Yes, can add stagger as a config toggle; will include as interim in the PR so we can enable without full deploy.

rachel: Sounds good. Please update the tracker when PR is merged and add a note to the postmortem about recurring "backup overlap on cold starts".

diego: Will do. Thanks for the ping — pushing the interim in a minute.

ops-bot: PR 4701 build passed, canary succeeded in staging at 1807711699.

rachel: Verified staging canary. Updated tracker and closed Action Item #7. :white_check_mark:

diego: Follow-up: will open low-priority task to optimize cold-start batching; not blocking closure.

rachel: Thanks — closing thread."
